$comment: Clone groups of scripts/audit/clones_struct.py kept on purpose. A group is silenced when EVERY copy's file matches one of `files` (and, with `name`, one copy is that function). Triaged 2026-10-24 (docs/code-audit.md).

entries.name: read
entries.reason: each host's RepositoryHost.read: one call of the shared dispatch (hosts.read_page) with its own file, history and thread readers; the readers differ, the call's shape cannot

entries.name: _read_history
entries.reason: each host's history read: the same page shape over different query names (sha vs ref_name), item fields (commit.committer.date vs committed_date) and pagination (Link vs X-Next-Page); folding them would move the host's API into a parameter table

product_doc_extractor is stdlib + boto3 only by design (no powertools, cannot import shared; its module docstring) and keeps marked copies of is_conditional_check_failure and the invocation-cost helpers

operator scripts: (1) the CloudFormation output lookups stay in each script because scripts/audit/stack_outputs.py resolves a helper's OutputKey reads only within the file that defines it, so one imported helper would hide every caller's output key from that gate; (2) parse_args declares each script's own flags (env defaults, table names, --dry-run/--apply wording)

operator backfills (7.19.00, 7.48.00), the entry above's reasons: each keeps its own CloudFormation output lookup (scripts/audit/stack_outputs.py reads an OutputKey only in the file that defines the helper), its own flags in parse_args and the main that resolves its table from them

projects_handler._validated_source_ids (document ids: keyed ownership read per id, ValidationError, 'names more than N documents') vs radar_brands._domains (host names: URL/www stripping and a regex, ValueError the brand-list route words as '{brand} radar_domains may hold at most N domains'); a common helper would take the parser, the exception and both messages as parameters

wire DTOs of two unrelated records (a voting session's facilitator view with derived row/state fields and created_by left out on purpose; an uploaded product document); equal only in being field-by-field dict projections with defaults

optional-field validators whose 400 wording and rules are each route's contract: form fields checked unstripped ('must be a string'), company-context lists ('may hold at most N entries'), dimension config lists raising ValueError ('At most N <what> are allowed'), draft intent text ('must be text' / 'is too long (at most N characters)', stripped after the check), Prioritization axis text (stripped before the check, '' -> None); one helper would need the type, exception, strip order and both messages as parameters

entries.name: _deleted_key
entries.reason: unrelated: a batch delete's re-sent key, checked to be a DeleteRequest (the workspace layer), and an Exa API key's format check; they only share the nested-get-and-raise shape

entries.name: _run_prd
entries.reason: a run's PRD ids checked at each of its two boundaries: the global MCP server's engineering_request_run tool (_prd_arg) answers the model with its own InvalidToolArgument and its id_arg before it calls the Agents API route, which checks the body again with the API's ValidationError and validated_row_id (_run_prd); one shape, each layer's own refusal (7.53.00)

entries.name: __init__
entries.reason: two unrelated time-boxed caches whose constructors only store their settings and an empty dict: the GitHub App keys' and connection credentials' SSM reads (credentials._CachedParameters) and the Radar's brand labels (radar_routing.BrandLabels); nothing to share but the assignments

entries.name: _engineering_caller
entries.reason: each engineering router's own gate helper (an admin acting for themselves, or the MCP tool of one operation), over its own _caller(): test_route_admin_gates follows module-local helpers to the admin gate, so the gate stays in each router where that test can see it
